en: The Only Living Pickpocket In New York
orig: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
plotEn:
Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who lives in The Bronx, New York City, with his wife Rosie, who is catatonic and unable to speak. Harry does not own a cell phone and has very limited understanding of modern technology.
One evening, Harry pickpockets a young man, Dylan, and steals a duffel bag from his car, which he promptly discards after finding a gun inside. After discovering he has been robbed, Dylan identifies Harry using surveillance cameras.
The next day, Harry visits his friend Ben, who owns a pawn shop and is the fence for his stolen goods. Harry presents him with a variety of cell phones, Dylan's watch, and Dylan's USB crypto wallet; neither of them can identify the USB device. Ben plugs the device into an old computer but is unable to open it. He recommends that Harry visit Frank, a fence in Chinatown who is more familiar with electronics.
Harry goes to Frank's Chinese herb shop. Frank buys the device from Harry, along with some smartphones. On his way home, Harry passes Ben's shop to discover it has been ransacked. Unbeknownst to Harry, the device had a tracker on it; after locating the shop, Dylan destroyed it in search of the device. An apologetic Ben admits that he was forced to divulge Harry's home address.
